tagline: The unglamorous four that actually change blood work.
description: Omega-3, vitamin D3, magnesium and a sensible multivitamin. No category is more affected by ingredient *form*: magnesium oxide and magnesium glycinate are not the same purchase, and most labels are betting you don't know that.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your daily essentials?
copy.empty_title: Nothing here clears our bar yet.
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 90 daily essentials products reaching Kuwait and published none. A shelf is whatever clears our listing floor, and nothing in this category does yet — we would rather show you an empty shelf than a padded one.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Products a founder put on the shelf from the database, whatever their score.

types.name: Omega-3
types.purpose: EPA and DHA. The supplement most people take at a dose too small to matter.
non_negotiables: Combined EPA + DHA of 1000 mg or more per daily serving, stated on the front
Triglyceride or re-esterified triglyceride form, not ethyl ester alone
IFOS, Friend of the Sea or equivalent sourcing certification

types.name: Vitamin D3 & K2
types.purpose: The one deficiency that is near-universal in a climate where nobody trains outdoors at noon.
non_negotiables: 1000–4000 IU per serving — no 50,000 IU novelty doses
Fat carrier present, since D3 is fat-soluble

types.name: Magnesium
types.purpose: Sleep, cramp and recovery support. Form matters more here than in any other category.
non_negotiables: Glycinate, malate, citrate or threonate — never oxide as the primary form
Elemental magnesium stated, not just compound weight

types.name: Athlete Multivitamin
types.purpose: Insurance against the gaps a training diet leaves. Not a performance product.
non_negotiables: Active vitamin forms — methylfolate over folic acid, methylcobalamin over cyanocobalamin
No mega-dosing above tolerable upper intake levels
No artificial colours in the coating

types.name: Zinc
types.purpose: Immune and hormonal support, at a dose that does not displace copper.
non_negotiables: Chelated form — picolinate, bisglycinate or citrate
